The exact direct reserve is therefore one Janus Henderson Anemoy AAA CLO Fund share exposure with credit, custody, liquidity, legal, and concentration risks retained.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The June 2026 issuer factsheet names J. P. Morgan as custodian and Trident Trust (Cayman) as administrator. It does not identify provider allocations, custody-account segregation terms, bankruptcy-remoteness safeguards, or rehypothecation restrictions. No later primary service-provider disclosure was found in this review.
